brief: The canvas displays an intricate, symmetrical composition of deep jewel tones, dominated by sapphire blues, ruby reds, and burnished gold. The pattern is composed of continuous, stylized floral and geometric motifs woven into a lattice grid. While the background pattern slowly and imperceptibly drifts, suggesting the subtle flow of time, the entire structure is rooted in deep symmetry. When the viewer clicks anywhere on the canvas, the existing pattern structure ripples outwards from the point of contact, momentarily brightening and disrupting the flow before settling back into its slow, steady rhythm.
